last.verdict: Investors cheered extra subscribers and a stronger profit outlook, shrugging off the earnings miss.

reasons.label: Subscribers beat forecasts
reasons.text: Premium subscribers hit 306 million, about 1 million above forecasts, with 9% growth.

reasons.label: Stronger profit outlook
reasons.text: Q4 operating profit guided to €820 million, above analyst estimates.

reasons.label: Margins and costs improved
reasons.text: Operating income of €672 million beat guidance on lower marketing and staff costs.

story: Spotify jumped about 16% in February on strong subscriber growth. It fell roughly 14% in April on a soft profit outlook, then slipped in August after a weaker profit forecast. October's subscriber beat and bigger profit guidance flipped sentiment back.
